about.title: About Me
about.AboutMe: Hi! I'm Xagly a Full-Stack Web Developer with a passion for all things creative. In addition to my web development stack, I embarked in a new journey in order to improve the user experience through research and design. Therefore, I am currently working on a UX Design Professional Certificate in order to create digital products that are not only enjoyable, useful and visually appealing, but also ensure an equitable user experience.  When time allows, I enjoy producing electronic music ands experimenting with visuals through code and video editing software.
